title: Integration of Rational Functions by Partial Fractions
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: Partial Fraction Decomposition Theorem
definitions.latex: \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)} = \sum \frac{A_i}{(x - r_i)^{k_i}} + \sum \frac{B_j x + C_j}{(x^2 + b_j x + c_j)^{m_j}}
definitions.statement: Any proper rational function P(x)/Q(x) with real coefficients can be uniquely decomposed into a sum of partial fractions corresponding to the linear and irreducible quadratic factors of its denominator.
conditions: Denominator Q(x) factored completely over R
definitions.explanation: Reduces rational integration into elementary logarithms and inverse tangents.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Linear factors produce logarithms; irreducible quadratics produce inverse tangents.
